title: Polynomial representation of a linear map
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $L\colon\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb C$ be a continuous real-linear map. There is a polynomial $P$ in $n$ variables with complex coefficients such that, for every $x\in\mathbb R^n$, evaluating $P$ at the complex coordinates of $x$ gives $L(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a continuous real-linear map from $\mathbb R^n$ to $\mathbb C$
